name: Ring of Summoning Affinity (Agathion)
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 218
Aura faint conjuration [good] CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 7,700 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring is forged from electrum and inlaid with runes. If the wearer can cast summon monster spells, the wearer adds silvansheeB2 to the 3rd-level list of monsters she can summon with those spells, adds vulpinalB2 to the 5th-level list, adds avoralB2 to the 7th-level list, and adds leonalB2 to the 8th-level list. Also, once per day on command the wearer can use this ring to summon a silvanshee, as if by the summon monster III spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, planar ally or planar binding, creator must be neutral good; Cost 3,850 gp
